subject: gl.report.heterozygosity stopped working after update to R 3.6.3

messages.author: 5b8ab0dd87de1735
messages.subject: gl.report.heterozygosity stopped working after update to R 3.6.3
parts:
I have been using the gl.report.heterozygosity function without problems before, but after updating R to 3.6.3 and reinstalling the packages it seems to not work correctly anymore. Even on the testdata the heterozygosity is the same value for all populations (see attached figure), and the same happens on my data which worked fine before.

Not sure if I am missing a required package now, or if there is a bug in relation to the new version of R?

messages.author: e64f7bb1494774f9
messages.subject: Re: [dartR] gl.report.heterozygosity stopped working after update to R 3.6.3
parts:
Make sure you have the following attached: SNPRelate, qvalue (not on Cran anymore, need to get from Bioconductor), and plyr.

You can also just run the source code here in a pinch:  https://github.com/green-striped-gecko/dartR/blob/master/R/gl.report.heterozygosity.r

messages.subject: Re: gl.report.heterozygosity stopped working after update to R 3.6.3
parts: Hi Kevin, The issue is with sepops() in the latest adegenet update not working (which gl.report.heterozygosity requires). You have to install a previous verison of adegenet
